name: Plain conventional prose
text: Every morning I get up and make breakfast. Then I go to work and talk to the people in my office. At the end of the day I come home and make dinner. Sometimes I watch television before I go to bed.

name: Varied narrative
text: Stop! The bus lurched past my corner while I wrestled a dripping umbrella into its sleeve, one shoe planted in yesterday's muddy pothole. Perfect timing. Somewhere behind me, a kid laughed; I nearly did too.

name: Repeated unusual vocabulary
text: The xylophonic zephyr perplexes the quincunx. The quincuncial zephyr perplexes the syzygy. The syzygetic zephyr perplexes the xylophone. The xylophonic zephyr perplexes the quincunx.
